prerequisites: Skills in highlevel object oriented programming environments

learning_outcomes.text: The graduate has adequate knowledge related to the use of integrated development environments for creating large complex applications.
The graduate is familiar with traditional and agile development methodologies.
The graduate has the ability to create automated tests of different levels of granularity for quality assurance of the developed systems.
The graduate is familiar with tools used for testing, debugging, validating software applications.
The graduate is familiar with methods for testing and verifying software systems.
The graduate is familiar with project management tools, version control systems, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) concepts, methods, tools.
The graduate has the ability to understand and communicate information effectively.
The graduate has the ability to observe and obtain information from various sources.

syllabus_topics: Program testing (1): the concept of program testing; unit testing: testing criteria – black box testing
Program testing (2): the concept of program testing; unit testing: testing criteria – white box testing (cont.)
Program testing (3): Levels of testing (unit, integration, system, regression, acceptance)
The theory of program correctness. The evolution of the concept of program correctness.
Dijkstra: the weakest precondition.Stepwise refinement from specifications
Verification/testing related activities: Technical testing skills, Soft testing skills, Giving, feedback.
Web testing tool (e.g. Selenium Web Driver)

assessment_methods.method: Bonus points for additional activities (research/report, activities during lectures, R&D project)

assessment_rules: The final grade is computed as 50% Written Exam + 25% Seminar + 25% Laboratory, and must be at least 5 to pass. Students must attend 75% of seminar activities and 90% of lab activities. Seminar/Laboratory assignments may not be redone in the retake session, but written exams can. For students from previous years, seminar/laboratory assignments and practical laboratory activity must be redone during didactic activity time.
